routing_contract.requested_operation: ObservedExecutionRequestV1.requested_action.capability_id and CanonicalExecutionContextV1.authority.capability_id identify the business operation and must match under the producer contract
routing_contract.protocol_marker: TenantContextEnvelope.authorization.capability_ids contains company_authority_v1 only as a protocol capability marker, not as the requested business operation
routing_contract.production_opt_in_selector: implemented as explicit HandleTenantSlackRequestOptions.company_authority.opted_in_capability_ids routing seam; production configuration is absent and production opt-in operations remain 0
routing_contract.foundation_boundary: handleTenantSlackRequest invokes resolveCompanyAuthorityRuntimeEnvelope only for an explicitly opted-in business capability and uses a distinct Company Authority envelope sender; the direct executeCompanyAuthorityWorkerIngress foundation remains independently fixture-tested
routing_contract.pre_binding_behavior: a same-run transient pre-fix actual-handler RED observed the selected operation flowing to the legacy path; no durable RED artifact was retained. The current regression test proves that an unavailable CompanyAuthorityClient yields AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE with Company Authority sender 0 and legacy authority calls 0. A selector containing only company_authority_v1 does not select task.write. No production client or sender is configured, so production opt-in operations remain 0
routing_contract.scope_binding: Company Authority v1 carries one resource_ref/project_hint. An opted-in Slack placement with more than one projectCode fails before retrieval with AUTHORITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH instead of collapsing to its first project. Slack ingress appends a JCS SHA-256 digest of the complete SlackQueueEvent to the signed resource_ref and worker.queue recomputes it before tenant runtime selection, preventing same-event payload substitution. RuntimePlacement.placementId is a local route identifier and is not the signed deployment ID; trusted expected_deployment_id is checked by the A0 consumer against the signed context
routing_contract.positive_handler_decision_evidence: positive fixture propagation from the HTTP handler is not_collected; approval/human_action Queue-to-pending effect-zero is locally verified, while production Queue, notification, owner-visible decision, completion, downstream effect and readback remain not_collected
